name: What preparation is needed before kitchen floor replacement?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before kitchen floor replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before kitchen floor replacement, several steps are usually necessary. This includes clearing out all furniture and appliances from the kitchen area. The existing flooring will be removed, and the subfloor will be inspected for any damage, moisture, or unevenness. Any necessary repairs or leveling of the subfloor will be completed to ensure a stable and smooth base for the new flooring material. This preparation is crucial for a durable and long-lasting installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation for kitchen floor replacement includes clearing the kitchen, removing old flooring, and inspecting/repairing the subfloor.
